attributes.title: AGPA Connect 2027
attributes.summary:
AGPA Connect 2027 takes place February 22 to 27, 2027, at the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel. It has three parts: a one-day Special Institute on February 22, a two-day experiential institute in small training groups on February 23 and 24, and a three-day conference from February 25 to 27.

Early-bird registration closed on October 30, 2026; regular registration is open. The fee amounts and the full session list are not public yet. Plenary speakers include Ramani Durvasula, Candis Smith, Jan Morris and Dennis Kivlighan Jr., and Resmaa Menakem will appear at a public education event. Cancellations are accepted until February 2, 2027, with a $50 charge.

AGPA is ACCME-accredited for physicians, APA-approved for psychologists and an ASWB ACE provider (#1064) for social workers. Its accreditation page also lists the state boards that accept these credits for counselors and MFTs. In 2026 psychologists could earn up to 39 hours, and AGPA did not offer ANCC nursing credit. The 2027 credit totals are not published yet.
